profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Newsela | Founder & Software Engineer at Categorized
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer with a focus in web-application development. I have a strong passion for developing applications that have intuitive UIs buoyed by a performant codebase. 

I value a work environment that champions kindness, hard work and a healthy work-life balance.I currently work as a lead software engineer at Newsela, a wonderful web and mobile application that provides customizable reading content to educators and students. I work on the web team (Python/BigQuery/dbt/FastAPI/DRF/Django, React/TypeScript, Node, Jest, MySQL, AWS).

I am also the founder and lone software engineer of Categorized (available at www.categorizedtweets.com). Categorized is a web application that scans the Twitter timelines of politicians (and key influencers) and sorts qualifying tweets into nine key categories. I built the app from front (React, d3.js) to back (Rails, Postgres, Sidekiq, Redis, Heroku). It's been such a joy to provide a powerful resource to thousands of users. My pronouns are she/her.

positions.description:

I am the founder and lone software engineer. I built the app from front (React, d3.js) to back (Rails, Postgres, Sidekiq, Redis, Heroku). It's been a pleasure providing such a powerful resource to thousands of users. The app went viral during the 2018 US midterm elections.

positions.title: Software Engineer Fellowship
positions.description: Worked on the software development needs of the 11 start-ups that comprised this accelerator's Spring 2017 cohort. Tech stacks included Django, Rails and React.

positions.title: Software Engineer Teaching Fellow
positions.description: Conducted 1:1 remote tutoring sessions with beginner programmers by guiding them through an 8-week online web-development curriculum that teaches Javascript, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Responsive Design/UI and Git
